recipe.ores_and_drills.ore_generation.or: This ore doesn't fit in the deposit palette and keeps its ordinary veins.

block.ores_and_drills.burner_mining_dril: Mines ore below it. Burns solid fuel.
block.ores_and_drills.electric_mining_dr: Mines ore below and around it. Powered by electricity.
block.ores_and_drills.advanced_mining_dr: Mines ore over a large area. Powered by electricity.
block.ores_and_drills.ultimate_mining_dr: Mines ore over a huge area. Powered by electricity.
gui.ores_and_drills.ore_settings.title: Ore Generation Settings
gui.ores_and_drills.ore_settings.vanilla: Small deposits generate like ordinary Minecraft ore: in the same places, at the same depths and in the same sizes. Each block holds one ore, so there is as much ore as in a normal world. Large deposits are unchanged. Small deposits can't be found with /locate. Small deposit blocks show as many ore specks as ordinary ore.
gui.ores_and_drills.settings.title: Ores & Drills settings
gui.ores_and_drills.settings.min_spacing: Minimum distance in blocks between MEDIUM/LARGE deposits. At least 50.
gui.ores_and_drills.settings.max_spacing: Maximum distance in blocks between MEDIUM/LARGE deposits, with no upper limit. Swapped with the minimum on save if smaller.
gui.ores_and_drills.settings.small_place: Where TINY/SMALL deposits are built in normal generation. Cave wall: next to a nearby cave wall so the deposit is visible, otherwise at the original attempt. Original spot: always at the ore's original attempt, with its height, biome and air exposure.
gui.ores_and_drills.settings.growth.tool: Exponential growth coefficient for hand-mining time of concentrated deposits. 0 keeps only linear scaling.
gui.ores_and_drills.settings.max_multipl: Cap of the additional exponential multiplier for hand-mining deposits. The linear ore-count multiplier always applies separately.
gui.ores_and_drills.settings.preset.tool: Active ore settings preset from datapacks (data/<namespace>/ore_settings_presets/<path>.json). The list of presets is known inside a world.
gui.ores_and_drills.settings.ignored_ore: Ore blocks or block tags the mod leaves alone: no deposits, no unification, not counted in rarity. They generate as in vanilla or as their mod intends. Affects new chunks after the world is reloaded.
Block ID or tag, e.g. minecraft:coal_ore or #c:ores/uranium
gui.ores_and_drills.settings.mod_priorit: When several mods add the same material, the ore of the mod higher in this list is used.
gui.ores_and_drills.mod_priorities.title: Mod priorities
gui.ores_and_drills.mod_priorities.hint: Drag by the grip on the right; mods not in the list rank last
gui.ores_and_drills.mod_priorities.empty: The list is empty: all mods have equal priority
gui.ores_and_drills.mod_priorities.not_i: Mod is not installed — it will be used once added to the pack
gui.ores_and_drills.mod_priorities.inval: Invalid mod ID (lowercase letters, digits and _)
gui.ores_and_drills.mod_priorities.dupli: This mod is already in the list
